H5.label: DEFERRED
H5.reason: S6 requires MEASURED crossing-range latency versus delta span. Nothing here runs a TieredCube read at spans 31/45/64/90/124; the numbers below are volume arithmetic only and are not a latency measurement.

inode_headroom.label: DEFERRED
inode_headroom.reason: `df -i` free inodes on the production filesystem. A temp dir on this machine says nothing about VM24's inode table, and a full inode table is an outage with plenty of free bytes. Needs VM24 read-only.

metadata_scan_on_the_production_tree.label: DEFERRED
metadata_scan_on_the_production_tree.reason: Scan cost is dominated by the filesystem's directory implementation and cache state at ~1.7M-6.6M files. Local timings do not extrapolate.

open_fd_and_RSS_under_sustained_load.label: DEFERRED
open_fd_and_RSS_under_sustained_load.reason: H7's C=8/16 over 10 minutes is an S7 load-gate measurement against the real store; this harness runs no HTTP layer.

peak_temp_disk_at_production_scale.label: DEFERRED
peak_temp_disk_at_production_scale.reason: 47/71/141 GB is arithmetic from 1.57 GB/day. Confirming it requires building one real block, which is a VM24 mutation.

production_366d_point_latency.label: DEFERRED
production_366d_point_latency.reason: §10.4's 0.65 ms per extra segment call is a laptop-measured projection against a VM24 baseline of 76-100 ms. Measuring it at fixture extent would produce a number that looks like the gate and is not.
